title: Finite lists over a countable type are countable
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and use countability as in [def-sfb-countable-set]. Let $X$ be any countable type. The type $\operatorname{List}(X)$ of all finite ordered lists of elements of $X$, including the empty list, is countable.
